_comment: Pinned provenance for the cap_evidence_integrity p0 prereq gate (review F2 fix). The gate's primary inputs are the machine-local run ledgers under experiments/results/workflows/ (gitignored, never provenance); when those are absent (fresh checkout), the gate falls back to these pinned run records — the git_sha of each prerequisite campaign's run at its completion, plus its ok flag. Regenerate by hand only when a prerequisite campaign re-runs: copy the four values from the newest ledger of each spec.
